title: Introduction to Scratch & Visual Logic
description: Learn foundational programming logic using block-based interfaces to build interactive games and animations.

title: Python Basics for Young Programmers
description: Transition from block coding to text-based syntax by learning variables, loops, and conditional statements in Python.

title: Web Development Fundamentals: HTML & CSS
hardware: Standard Laptop with VS Code Installed
description: Discover how websites are structured and styled by building responsive landing pages from scratch.

title: JavaScript Logic & DOM Manipulation
description: Add interactivity to websites by writing JavaScript functions, handling user events, and updating elements dynamically.

title: Introduction to Arduino Microcontrollers
description: Get hands-on with hardware by wiring circuits, blinking LEDs, and programming microcontrollers to read sensor data.

title: Robotics Circuitry & Sensor Integration
description: Combine ultrasonic sensors, motors, and motor drivers to build obstacle-avoiding autonomous mini-rovers.

title: App Development with JavaScript & APIs
description: Fetch real-world data from external sources and parse JSON responses to create dynamic web utility apps.

title: IoT Smart Home Automation Systems
description: Build Wi-Fi enabled smart devices using ESP32 microcontrollers to control home appliances remotely.

title: Mobile Game Design & Development
description: Design and code 2D arcade games optimized for touchscreens and mobile devices.

title: 3D CAD Modeling for Robotics Parts
description: Learn computer-aided design fundamentals to model custom chassis and brackets for 3D printing.

title: Advanced C++ for Microcontrollers
description: Master memory management and efficient coding practices using C++ for embedded hardware engineering.

title: Line-Following & Maze-Solving Robots
description: Program infrared reflectance arrays and PID control algorithms to build fast competition robots.

title: Data Structures & Problem Solving
description: Strengthen algorithmic thinking by implementing arrays, stacks, queues, and search algorithms.

title: Solar Energy & Renewable Tech Circuits
description: Explore green energy concepts by wiring miniature photovoltaic solar panels and battery storage units.

title: Capstone Robotics Prototype Project
description: Work in teams to design, solder, program, and showcase a fully functioning real-world robotics prototype.
